propositions: _pai_check_config raises unconditionally on any base_url/api_key configuration despite documentation and config parsing support already existing
registering an openai builder that constructs OpenAIChatModel with base_url injection, gated on cfg.base_url being set, allows OpenAI-compatible endpoints while keeping the openai SDK optional
a Provider subclass overriding model_profile staticmethod to set supports_json_schema_output=False prevents silent wrong answers by disabling strict output mode on arbitrary compatible servers
bare openai model strings without base_url must continue resolving via pydantic-ai's lazy path to avoid breaking existing tests and making the openai SDK mandatory
base_url is provider configuration not selection: REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER still determines which provider, and base_url only decides whether rebar constructs it or defers to pydantic-ai
ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL non-loopback gateway behavior works today by accident and must become deliberate and tested
